RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are men, so an all-male panel provides no basis for a claim of sex discrimination against you. Raising the panel's gender composition would appear unfounded, undermine your professional credibility, and damage relationships within a municipal network where you may apply again. 

While an all-male panel might reflect broader diversity shortcomings in the municipality's administration, it is not a sign of bias between two male applicants. The panel simply favored public consultation experience, interview performance, or organizational fit over your formal credentials. 

Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting constructive feedback focused strictly on competencies and future growth.
